overview:
Kinnaur's high villages from Delhi or Chandigarh: this **3 Nights / 4 Days** long-weekend trip covers Chitkul, the last village of India, Baspa Valley walks and a riverside day hike, Roghi Suicide Point, Kalpa and the Kinner Kailash views. You leave around 8 PM by AC Tempo Traveller or bus and travel overnight via Shimla.

Day 1 reaches Chitkul / Sangla with a stop at Kinnaur Gate, a sunset nature walk and a bonfire. Day 2 is a day hike across the Baspa River through the forest to sit by the river opposite the ITBP camp. Day 3 drives to Kalpa via Roghi Suicide Point and Reckong Peo market. Day 4 heads to Shimla past the Kinner Kailash peaks for the overnight bus to Delhi, arriving on Day 5. Stays are homestays: 2 nights in Chitkul / Sangla and 1 in Kalpa. Prices start at ₹10,500 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).

itinerary.title: Departure for Chitkul
itinerary.content:
Assemble at the pickup point in Delhi or Chandigarh around 8 PM and meet your team captain and the group.
Overnight journey by AC Tempo Traveller or bus.
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).

itinerary.title: Reach Chitkul / Sangla
itinerary.content:
Drive via Shimla, with a stop at Kinnaur Gate.
Reach Chitkul late noon and relax for a while.
Nature walk for the sunset and snow-clad mountain views.
Back to the homestay for a bonfire and dinner.

itinerary.title: Chitkul local exploration | Day hike
itinerary.content:
Breakfast with views of the Baspa Valley and snow-clad mountains.
After lunch, cross to the other side of the Baspa River for a short day hike through the forest, and sit by the river opposite the ITBP camp.
Back to the homestay for the sunset and dinner around the bonfire.

itinerary.title: Chitkul to Kalpa
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, leave Chitkul for Kalpa.
Stop at Roghi Suicide Point and Reckong Peo market.
Explore Kalpa village and its temple. Dinner and overnight stay in Kalpa.

itinerary.title: Kalpa to Shimla | Departure
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, leave Kalpa for Shimla.
Look out for the Kinner Kailash peaks along the way.
Board the overnight bus from Shimla to Delhi in the evening. Arrive in Delhi on Day 5.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: The group assembles at the pickup point in Delhi or Chandigarh and leaves around 8 PM, travelling overnight via Shimla. The final pickup point is shared with confirmed travellers before the trip.

faqs.q: How much does the Chitkul, Sangla & Kalpa trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹10,500 per person on quad sharing, ₹11,000 on triple sharing and ₹11,500 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

2 homestay nights in Chitkul / Sangla and 1 in Kalpa, 3 breakfasts and 3 dinners, an AC Tempo Traveller, Innova or AC deluxe bus depending on group size, a trip leader, a bonfire with light music and local sightseeing.
A sunset nature walk on Day 1 and a short forest day hike across the Baspa River on Day 2. The rest of the trip is by road.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat with an advance of ₹3,000 per person by UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking, then clear the balance 24 hours before boarding. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
If you cancel, the ₹3,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances. There are also no refunds for any inclusion you don't use, and bookings cannot be transferred to someone else.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack a down or main jacket, thermals, socks and gloves, good shoes, a daypack, personal medication and a small first-aid kit. The full list is under Things To Pack.
